name: code
description: Grouped code workflows under one /code umbrella with subcommands (e.g. /code prepare-pr). prepare-pr is full PR readiness (deterministic preflight, quality gates, source-grounded QA, validation, PR text, commits, push/PR update, gate-before-push), review-and-commit is quick local review plus commit, and thermo-nuclear is a strict evidence-backed structural audit.
